verdict.rationale: The relay's own docs describe issuing tokens scoped to the operations each client needs, such as a subscribe-only token, with additional tokens and expiration times available via the API. An agent client can therefore get least-privilege data-plane access. However, the scoping shown is coarse (publish/subscribe only), and these are session tokens for the relay rather than scoped management-API credentials. Missing for 10: finer-grained scoping (per-namespace or per-track) documented, scoped credentials for the management API itself, agent-specific credential guidance, revocation details, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: You control who can publish and who can subscribe by issuing tokens scoped to the operations each client needs.
Cloudflare returns a relay ID and two default tokens: one that can publish and subscribe, and one that can only subscribe.
You can create additional tokens and set expiration times using the [API](/api/resources/moq).
